name: sleek
description: Sleek's remote MCP server for Claude Code. Design your mobile app UI with AI, then have Claude build the real app from it.

plugins.name: sleek
plugins.description: Connects Claude Code to Sleek's remote MCP server (https://sleek.design/api/mcp) to create projects, design mobile app screens from a description of your app, fetch each screen's HTML to build from, and render screens as images. It can also permanently delete a project when you ask it to. Design runs spend your Sleek workspace's AI credits; listing, reading, and rendering are free, and sustained use requires a paid Sleek plan. MCP server only: no hooks, skills, agents, or commands.
